## Checklist

- [ ] `loadouts validate loadouts/<name>.yml` passes
- [ ] The filename matches `name`, and the leading comment explains what the loadout adds
- [ ] Includes use `github:` sources
- [ ] A changeset is added (`pnpm changeset`), or a maintainer will add one
